items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: and Bill Russell asked me about this

ctx.x: Now, what I can't understand, and Bill Russell asked me about this, what we can't understand is, what is it, was it something about the music that would start the fight?

I know, but see, it's the time that we played, you know what I mean? We'd have a break, you know, half hour break, you see. While I'd do it all that time, well, the cats would be drinking, you know. during prohibition time, but they always wasn't bootlegged. Yeah. And they'd get half stewed up, you know, it didn't take much to start a fight after then, you know, it'd be probably after 12 o'clock, or the other after one, when we supposed to play until two, sometime later. Yeah. Well, we'd play this particular…
